decisions.reason: Locates cordis.patch.yml, patch.yml and the patch script, correctly classifies the patch.yml target against host session-view source as a true source patch distinct from ordinary profile composition, and grounds the private session-view coupling in the SessionView.ts target and A1-03 revalidation need.

Finds the producer, consumer and ignorable:true in src/index.ts, applies corridor folding to map the net state to A2-01 (restored), explains omission-safe retention rather than a consumer whitelist, and correctly notes public Session.append has no ignorable parameter as a capability gap.

Locates both ctx.get('apiProxy') call sites and the A1-01 removal; distinguishes Host-plane domain-service injection (llm/listProviders via ctx.llm) from the client-face Remote and explicitly warns against the nonexistent Host remote rewrite.

Locates the hard-coded homedir/.dsh/profiles/default path and write, maps it to A1-04's no-hardcoded-user-directories guidance, and prescribes runtime DSH_HOME/profile resolution without claiming --profile was introduced in alpha.1.

Locates both the dsh-session-view/internal SessionView import and the registerCommand call, and explains re-verifying the public owner/seam after the internals split, marking uncertain paths as pending confirmation per A1-03 rather than guessing.

Locates the private loopback HTTP server on 43121 including the dead-code detail; states loopback is not an auth exemption under A1-08 and distinguishes Connection-authenticated host channels from raw ctx.webServer routes lacking auth/Origin/CORS.

Locates both dsh subprocess call sites with per-line JSON.parse, explains stdout as final assistant text versus stderr reasoning/progress with exit code authoritative, and identifies the JSONL assumption as already wrong (A1-05) rather than inventing an alpha.2 stdout change.

Each located coupling is mapped to its card: A1-03 (patch and UI), A2-01 net of A1-02 (events), A1-01 (services), A1-04 (path), A1-08 (channel), plus the valid A1-05 for stdout parsing; mappings are tied to cited hit locations, not a bare card list.

Accounts for all seven categories as hits, includes a limitations section on static-copy scope, and proposes target-version build/typecheck, isolated-profile composition boot, and a real host mount functional flow without requiring execution of the static fixture.
